race.description: Wauchope Bonny Surf Club C2 & Above (Bm58) Hcp
race.comment: AEROFOIL (9) got too far back fresh then progressed nicely last time out when sent forward here and never gave his rivals a sniff. Draws to do the same, so if he can hold that form he can repeat the dose. ROYAL TEENS (10) is knocking on the door and will appreciate returning to this track where he boasts a strong record. Draws well and has fresh legs. Big threat. FANCY SHOULDER (13) made a bright in the new colours when resuming off a long break at Inverell. Found the line nicely for third last time and is heading the right way but she will need some luck from out there. TRYANZA (6) has been thereabouts in his two runs back and has enough early dash to offset the wide alley if they want. Fitter and is in the mix.
